give_up_rate.source: County Medi-Cal Call Center Data, CA Dept. of Health Care Services via CHHS Open Data, https://data.chhs.ca.gov/dataset/county-medi-cal-call-center-data (CHHS Terms of Use: free use and distribution with attribution; the data.ca.gov listing says Creative Commons Attribution)
give_up_rate.definition: source data dictionary (average-call-abandonment-rate-data-dictionary.csv): calls abandoned by the caller after entering the queue for a live agent / calls that entered the queue; after-hours calls, hang-ups before the queue and queued call-backs are not counted; 'between 0 and 1, ... 0.5 representing 50%'. So 0.28 = 28% (median county-month, Jan-Jun 2026; IQR 0.20-0.37).
give_up_rate.note: public-benefits call centers with long waits (median 28 min per county-month), not retail/travel chat
